page_title: MON 1-4 LEN | Monaco v Lens 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Denis Zakaria (Monaco) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Penalty saved! Ansu Fati (Monaco) sends the penalty towards the bottom left corner, but Robin Risser pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
90+3' Ansu Fati (Monaco) is going to take the penalty!
90+3' The Monaco players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+2' Referee Bastien Dechepy makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Monaco. Let’s see what happens!
90+2' Handball! A player from Lens handled the ball. It's a penalty to Monaco! Let's see who's going to take it.
90+1' The referee blows his whistle, Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' What a save from Robin Risser! George Ilenikhena (Monaco) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
89' Rayan Fofana (Lens) is penalised for a foul. Bastien Dechepy had a clear view and blows his whistle.
88' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
87' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
84' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Ruben Aguilar will be replaced by Anthony Bermont (Lens).
84' It will be a substitution. Florian Sotoca (Lens) is ready to enter the pitch as Adrien Thomasson walks off.
82' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Rayan Fofana (Lens) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Philipp Kohn was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
81' Rayan Fofana (Lens) latches onto a short pass from Matthieu Udol inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
80' Lucas Michal (Monaco) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
79' Mamadou Coulibaly will be replaced by Denis Zakaria (Monaco).
79' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Philipp Kohn is alert and denies him with a nice save.
77' Matthieu Udol (Lens) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
75' Caio Henrique (Monaco) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
75' Caio Henrique (Monaco) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
74' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Ruben Aguilar (Lens) for his blatant foul.
73' Substitution. Ansu Fati (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Maghnes Akliouche walks off.
72' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Rayan Fofana (Lens) replaces Odsonne Edouard.
72' Substitution. Wesley Said is replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
69' Lens enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
67' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
66' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Monaco.
65' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:9.
63' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Mamadou Sangare is replaced by Andrija Bulatovic (Lens).
61' Substitution. Mika Biereth makes his way off the pitch and George Ilenikhena (Monaco) comes on as his replacement.
61' Substitution. Pape Cabral (Monaco) in, Jordan Teze out.

60' 1 - 4 Florian Thauvin sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Wesley Said (Lens), who outjumps the defence to put the ball into the roof of the net with a stunning header. The score is 1:4.
60' The ball goes out for a corner. Lens can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Matthieu Udol plays a short pass through to Wesley Said (Lens) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar.
57' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

57' Excellent touch by Florian Thauvin (Lens)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
57' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
55' Florian Thauvin (Lens) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

54' Wesley Said (Lens) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Philipp Kohn, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
54' Lens are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
52' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
51' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
50' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) makes a strong challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul.
48' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes.
46' That's the end of the game for Aleksandr Golovin, who is replaced by Lucas Michal (Monaco).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' 1 - 3 Goal! Florian Thauvin puts a cross into the box and finds Mamadou Sangare (Lens), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:3.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' Very strict call by the referee! He pulls out the red card and sends Folarin Balogun (Monaco) off the pitch.
45' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
44' The ball goes out of play. Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
43' Lens force their opponents to concede a corner.

40' 1 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Wesley Said (Lens) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot into the top left corner. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.

39' Wesley Said (Lens) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. Philipp Kohn has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Robin Risser.
37' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
37' Referee Bastien Dechepy is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Monaco!
35' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Monaco using VAR. Let's see what happens.
35' Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mamadou Sangare (Lens). PENALTY AWARDED to Monaco!
33' Great teamplay by Monaco as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
31' Monaco are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
29' Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
29' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
24' 4:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Odsonne Edouard (Lens) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
20' Caio Henrique (Monaco) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
19' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
17' Nice passing game by Lens. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
14' The game is interrupted. Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
14' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Good work from Lens as they win a corner.
12' The ball is cleared after Florian Thauvin (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
8' The Lens players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' A fine pass finds Folarin Balogun (Monaco) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Robin Risser reacts superbly to deny him.
6' Monaco hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
4' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) dribbles into the box, but Robin Risser is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
3' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
3' Now Lens have a corner.
2' The Monaco players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Monaco will have the kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy is the one to supervise the game today.
